description: This file defines functions for preserving environment variable references (`${VAR}`) during configuration write-back. It includes logic for detecting, resolving, and restoring environment variable references in configuration data, handling strings, arrays, and objects.

methods.name: hasEnvVarRef
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any `${VAR}` environment variable references.

methods.name: tryResolveString
methods.description: Resolves `${VAR}` references in a string using provided environment variables, returning null if any referenced variable is missing.

methods.name: restoreEnvVarRefs
methods.description: Recursively walks configuration data to restore `${VAR}` references where the resolved value matches the original, preserving environment variable references during config write-back.
